      "observations": [
        "All 819 owned diff lines across 27 paths were read. This is a functional CSS/extension port: variable names, native-popup defaults, platform notification overrides, dialog radii, Gloda colors and menu padding change. No test or assertion body changes.",
        "The landing moves shared background/text/border defaults from root arrowpanel variables into the descendant :is(menupopup, panel) rule. Normal-contrast dimmed variants are similarly scoped; Windows contrast retains SelectedItem overrides. The Gloda facet-popup-menu is a custom element, so its .popup-menu instead receives surface/text tokens directly and selected background/text on hover or focus. This is a receiver-specific token choice, not a global variable-renaming rule.",
        "BasePopup receives Extension:BrowserBackgroundChanged, finds its panel ancestor and writes --panel-background and, for white, --panel-border-color. Teardown removes these same names only for non-remote panels after browser readiness. The public popup_border theme key and popup_affordance example keep their external names while their CSS targets change. The fixed accepted shared CSS later uses --panel-background-color/--panel-text-color, whereas this BasePopup still writes --panel-background. The paired Gecko compatibility/alias implementation was not read, so this name difference alone does not prove a broken popup.",
        "All 13 actual submitted review bodies were read, including two replacement tables and the code-only token proposal. Source adopts surface tokens and removes the questioned ContentSelectDropdown color redeclaration and macOS hardcoded arrowpanel colors. The replacement typo var(color-surface-border-intense) is not copied: actual source has var(--color-surface-border-intense). The file/style move is explicitly deferred; the current missing mailWindow1.css is a later phase, not work credited here. Done labels alone are not source proof.",
        "The reviewer reports menu color/position jitter and requests changes, then the author reports a later fix and the reviewer accepts. Those are historical visual reports. The sole Show Details payload is referenced-file mode metadata, not a summary edit. Mica, contrast, native popup styling, keyboard focus and rendered accessibility were not executed. Existing focus selectors are inspected code, not a live accessibility result.",
        "The primary is complete current comments 0–2 plus activity and actual end controls, read by Parent. It has no human description or extra rationale beyond the port locator; the source and review provide the bounded behavior facts.",
        "The full own review is reconciled with all 13 actual submitted inline bodies and two replacement tables. File consolidation stays a follow-up. The source removes the questioned token redeclaration and hardcoded macOS colors, uses correctly spelled surface-token references, and keeps the explicitly discussed normal-contrast dimmed variants. Actual suggestion adoption is established from the owned diff, not Done or approval.",
        "Creation-to-close history preserves the reviewer-reported jitter, author-reported later fix and final acceptance. The referenced recording and upstream implementation remain unread; no fresh visual or compatibility cure is claimed."
